title: Positive Toeplitz operators on pluriharmonic Fock spaces: Schatten class criteria, sharp norm comparisons, and generalized weights
summary: Let $μ$ be a positive Borel measure on $\mathbb C^n$. We prove that, for every $0 0$. For $n\geq2$, this resolves a conjecture of Jaguzovi'c and Vujadinovi'c, and the range $0<p<1$ is new in every dimension.
